Other than these terms and conditions, bidder will be rejected if not submitting any document which is mentioned in the Bid document. 42) Specifications for Hand Held Slit Lamp

1. Should have Slit and Filter System 2. Should have rotating slit wheel selection type slit lamp 3. SLIT LENGTH should be 10-12mm 4. Slit widths 0.15mm, 0.5mm, 0.8mm and 1.6mm slits, 12mm circle and a 1mm square 5. SLIT ANGLE should be +/-60° 6. Filters should be Red free, Blue, Neutral density 0.8 and Clear 7. Should have Infra-Red protection with Inbuilt IR cut filter 8. Should have continuously variable Illumination control from low to full brightness 9. FIXATION TARGETS: LED system, double click of trigger 10. Capability to attach digital imaging devices (eg, smartphone adapter for real-time imaging or tele-opht halmology) 11. Biomicroscope should be Binocular Hand held 12. Biomicroscope Slit Lamp 13. OPTICS Converging binoculars should be at 13° 14. Magnification: From 10x to 16x, lever change 15. Objective lens working distance should be at 10x to 16x 16. FIELD OF VIEW: 10x to 16x 17. Eyepiece dioptric adjustment range: +/- 7 Dioptres 18. Weight of HAND HELD DEVICE ~ upto 1000g 19. Must include compatible carrying case for portability 20. Optional smartphone adapter should be offered 21. Must conform to national/international medical device safety and performance standards. 22.
